hero.titleEn: International Chinese Association of Computer Human Interaction, ICACHI
hero.subtitle: Founded on May 10, 2012, in Austin, USA (during ACM CHI 2012). The board was initiated by 27 overseas Chinese representatives active worldwide in the field of Human-Computer Interaction.

about.title: A global community for human-centered computing
about.summary: ICACHI was founded on May 10, 2012 in Austin, USA during the ACM CHI 2012 conference. Its board comprises 27 overseas Chinese HCI researchers active across the world, building bridges between academia, industry, and education.

conferences.title: Chinese CHI → ICHEC
conferences.titleSub: The International Symposium of Chinese CHI → International Conference on Human-Engaged Computing
conferences.subtitle: Since 2013, the association has held its annual academic conference in rotating cities around the world.
